entities.name: Dorotheus of Antioch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dorotheus was Arian Archbishop of Constantinople from c. 388 until his death in 407. Preceding his elevation to the see of Constantinople, Dorotheus had served as Arian bishop of Antioch, having succeeded Euzoius of Antioch in 376.
